title: NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own): HFIAA Surcharge, ICC Premium and Fees on Cancellation
content:
## The other premium lines on cancellation — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)

The lines rule decides the lines other than the risk premium and reserve fund assessment when a signed cancellation is processed:

- **Duplicate NFIP Policy or Closing Did Not Occur:** every HFIAA surcharge, ICC premium, Federal Policy Fee and probation surcharge booked on the policy is returned in full.
- **Removed from SFHA by LOMA or LOMR, or a cancellation that takes effect on or before the current term start:** the current term's HFIAA surcharge and ICC premium are returned in full and the fees are earned.
- **Otherwise:** the current term's HFIAA surcharge and ICC premium are returned at the term share (the days from the cancellation date to the term end divided by the days of the current term), each line rounded half-up to the cent, and the fees are earned.

"The fees" are the Federal Policy Fee and the probation surcharge.

| Reason or date | HFIAA surcharge and ICC premium | Federal Policy Fee and probation surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| Duplicate NFIP Policy, Closing Did Not Occur | Every one booked on the policy, in full | Every one booked on the policy, in full |
| Removed from SFHA by LOMA or LOMR; or effective on or before the term start | Current term's, in full | Earned |
| Any other | Current term's, at the term share | Earned |

*Hypothetical case.* A current-term HFIAA surcharge of 250.00 dollars, cancelled under Mortgage Paid Off with 73 of 365 days left: 50.00 dollars returned on that line; the fees are earned.
